titleEn: Find Nearest Point That Has the Same X or Y Coordinate
title: 找到最近的有相同 X 或 Y 坐标的点
summary: 有效点需与给定点共享 x 或 y 坐标，返回曼哈顿距离最小的有效点下标；并列取较小下标，无有效点返回负一。
insight: 按下标顺序扫描有效点，计算曼哈顿距离；只在严格更小时更新，便自然保留并列的最小下标。
pitfalls: 有效条件是共享任一坐标
曼哈顿距离为横纵差绝对值之和

solutions.title: 有效点线性扫描
solutions.idea: 一次遍历完成过滤、距离计算与下标平局规则。
steps: 遍历 points，若 px==x 或 py==y 则计算 distance
distance<bestDistance 时更新二者，返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int nearestValidPoint(int x,int y,int[][] points){int answer=-1,best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=0;i<points.length;i++)if(points[i][0]==x||points[i][1]==y){int distance=Math.abs(points[i][0]-x)+Math.abs(points[i][1]-y);if(distance<best){best=distance;answer=i;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun nearestValidPoint(x:Int,y:Int,points:Array<IntArray>):Int{var answer=-1;var best=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(i in points.indices)if(points[i][0]==x||points[i][1]==y){val distance=kotlin.math.abs(points[i][0]-x)+kotlin.math.abs(points[i][1]-y);if(distance<best){best=distance;answer=i}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int nearestValidPoint(int x,int y,vector<vector<int>>& points){int answer=-1,best=INT_MAX;for(int i=0;i<(int)points.size();++i)if(points[i][0]==x||points[i][1]==y){int distance=abs(points[i][0]-x)+abs(points[i][1]-y);if(distance<best){best=distance;answer=i;}}return answer;} };
